## Why it works

It is extremely fast (245 words a minute), live, and the woman styles her own hair, so the viewer sees it is doable. Each step fixes a bob problem the viewer recognizes. The comments thank exactly that: "I love how he shows HER how to style her hair and has her do it with his help." (249 likes); "This is the first time in my life that I have understood what is going on with my hair when I blow dry." (95 likes); "Now I know why I love my bob when I leave the hairdressers and feel frustrated when I do it myself." (86 likes). The biggest comment is about stylists, not him: "Unfortunately it's nearly impossible to find stylists that can actually cut a bob." (1K likes); "I have never found a stylist who puts so much thought into how they style hair." (171 likes). Complaints: hold ("I can style my hair so it looks like the one on the right,  and 10 minutes later,  it will morph into the one on the left." (234 likes)), the missing finish ("Felt like a cliff-hanger." (113 likes)) and the before and after ("Absolutely b.s.   Those are 2 very different cuts." (0 likes)). Some acted: "After watching this video I finally spent the money and got a larger one" (56 likes).
